name: RNF4
protac_suitability: HIGH - compact RING domain, multiple fragment hits, solvent-exposed regions
why_promising: Well-characterized RING domain, multiple fragment screening hits, involved in DNA damage response - validated biology

name: SMURF1
protac_suitability: HIGH - validated inhibitors, HECT domain druggability established, TGF-β pathway involvement
why_promising: First HECT ligase with validated small molecule inhibitors; TGF-β/BMP pathway critical in cancer; allosteric sites offer exit vectors

name: ARIH1
full_name: Ariadne RBR E3 Ubiquitin Protein Ligase 1 (HHARI)
protac_suitability: HIGH - emerging RBR ligase class, distinct from RING/HECT, CRL substrate regulation
why_promising: First RBR ligase with small molecules; part of CRL machinery (works with Cullin-RING ligases); novel mechanism

name: BIRC2
protac_suitability: HIGH - validated chemistry (Smac mimetics), apoptosis/NF-κB biology, clinical precedent
why_promising: Sister to cIAP1; extensive chemical matter from Smac mimetic programs; clinical validation; BIR domain offers distinct binding vs RING

name: FBXW7
full_name: F-Box and WD Repeat Domain Containing 7 (Cdc4)
protac_suitability: HIGH - tumor suppressor, substrate recognition druggable, molecular glue precedent
why_promising: Most commonly mutated E3 in cancer; WD40 domain offers molecular glue potential (like CRBN); cyclin E, c-Myc, Notch degradation

name: BTRC
full_name: Beta-Transducin Repeat Containing E3 Ubiquitin Protein Ligase (β-TrCP1)
protac_suitability: HIGH - Wnt/NF-κB signaling, β-catenin degradation, WD40 druggability emerging
why_promising: Critical Wnt pathway regulator; β-catenin, IκBα degradation; cancer/inflammation target; WD40 domain tractable

name: SMURF2
protac_suitability: HIGH - similar to SMURF1, validated chemistry, distinct substrate profile
why_promising: Paralog of SMURF1; shares druggability but distinct biology (p53 regulation, metastasis); offers complementary recruiter option

name: NEDD4
full_name: Neural Precursor Cell Expressed Developmentally Down-Regulated Protein 4
protac_suitability: MEDIUM-HIGH - established HECT ligase, inhibitors in development, Na+ channel regulation
why_promising: Prototype HECT ligase; multiple disease associations (cancer, neurodegeneration); structural biology well-established

name: WWP1
full_name: WW Domain Containing E3 Ubiquitin Protein Ligase 1
protac_suitability: HIGH - emerging cancer target, druggable HECT domain, p53/TGF-β regulation
why_promising: Oncogenic HECT ligase; validated chemical matter; critical in triple-negative breast cancer and bone metastasis

name: ARIH2
full_name: Ariadne RBR E3 Ubiquitin Protein Ligase 2 (TRIAD1)
protac_suitability: HIGH - paralog of ARIH1, CRL E3-E3 cooperation, cancer biology
why_promising: Works with CRLs to amplify ubiquitination; cancer-relevant; RBR druggability validated via ARIH1/Parkin
